subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the public meeting-runtime permission-plan API require `meetingUrl` immediately, or remain source-compatible while Teams adopts the new capability?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes a compatibility path from an exported plugin-SDK contract, and repository policy requires explicit maintainer-visible direction for plugin API evolution.

options.title: Keep it additive
options.body: Make `meetingUrl` optional or introduce an additive API, while Teams uses it when available and preserves a documented migration path.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK change
options.body: Retain the required field only with explicit owner approval, downstream migration guidance, and compatibility validation for plugin consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep it additive
recommendation.body: Make `meetingUrl` optional or introduce an additive API, while Teams uses it when available and preserves a documented migration path.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Teams adapter and authored both the prior merged implementation and this public-contract follow-up.
